 Match Preview
 Premier League - Game Week 10 8 Nov 2026 - 08:00 Stadium of Light Sunderland host Chelsea at the Stadium of Light on Sunday in a Premier League fixture that pits the bottom side against a team chasing a top-four finish.
 Regis Le Bris's Sunderland arrive in difficult shape. They have lost two of their last three league matches and sit rooted to the foot of the table, though Xabi Alonso acknowledged this week that the Black Cats deserve more points than their position suggests.
 Chelsea head north off the back of a 2-0 Premier League win over Manchester United, a result that lifted them into fourth place with 16 points from nine matches. Romeo Lavia completed 90 minutes in that victory and has now featured in every matchday squad this season after a long run of injuries following his move from Southampton.
 Cole Palmer will be in the travelling party despite being left out of England's Nations League squad by Thomas Tuchel. Xabi Alonso confirmed this week that he and Palmer have spoken about the red card the forward received against Tottenham, but the Chelsea head coach made clear his focus remains on club matters.
 Emiliano Martinez, recovering from a fractured jaw, is back in training wearing a protective mask and is in contention to start. Alonso will make a late call on the goalkeeper ahead of kick-off, while Moises Caicedo is also being monitored after missing part of training earlier in the week.
